settings.heading: Customize Your Fitness Superstore Gym Equipment

settings.text:
Elevate your workout space with personalized fitness gear and equipment tailored to your individual preferences!

Personalizing your gym equipment is a crucial part of designing your gym. The colors and logos showcase your distinct style and goals, whether you're building a home gym or a commercial fitness center. That's why we're proud to provide a wide array of customizable features, ensuring your gym equipment truly embodies your brand and personality.

settings.title: Paint Color Customization
settings.text: The largest selection of paint in which you can opt for any Pantone or RAL color to spruce up your equipment and match your gym’s interiors.

settings.title: Upholstery Color Customization
settings.text: Personalize your benches with our wide range of performance fabrics, offered in a vast selection of colors and textures to choose from.

settings.title: Printed Vinyl Decal
settings.text: Take your brand image up a notch by strategically placing your logo! Our vinyl decals can be placed on any plastic or metal surface.

settings.title: Color Customization
settings.description:
Choose among thousands of Pantone and RAL colors to find the best palette that will match your gym space! Paint customization is best applied on cages, racks, and rigs, benches, gym systems, and other heavy equipment with metal surfaces.

You can choose any Pantone or RAL color. Simply indicate the color code in the "Order Comments" upon checkout.

settings.title: Material options
settings.text: You can choose any option from the downloadable upholstery material and color guide. Simply indicate the color code upon check out.

settings.title: Custom options
settings.text: In the "order comments" at checkout, you may specify your customization preferences, and we'll provide the cost and timing.

settings.title: Custom Upholstery
settings.description: We offer a wide variety of colors and textures from our collection of performance fabrics, especially for vinyl wraps on upholstered gym equipment, specifically benches. We use only industry-standard vinyl materials that are durable and feature a luxurious appearance, making it the ideal choice for both home and commercial fitness facilities and we'll get back to you with the cost and timing.

settings.title: Surfaces
settings.text: Customization is offered for nearly all metal and plastic surfaces

settings.title: Lead Time
settings.text: 2 weeks on top of the estimated delivery date upon check out.

settings.title: Printed Vinyl Decal
settings.description:
Elevate your fitness facility’s brand recognition and image by deliberately placing your logo in all the right areas of your equipment. Our custom vinyl decal laser cut logos offer more flexibility in customization and placement, ranging from colored logos or monochromatic; plastic surfaces to metal racks. This is one of the most common logo placement methods utilized by commercial gyms on low-touch surfaces.

We can take any logo and install them onto your Fitness Superstore equipment. Simply send us the vector image at sales.cs@fitnesssuperstore.com with the following details:

  • Logo size
  • A screenshot of the equipment with arrows pointing to locations where you would like to place the logo

You can also specify in the "order comments" box on the checkout page your preferred customization - and we will get back to you with the cost and timing.
